abt.title: About
abt.desc:
llama.cpp && GGUF model manager: runs fully locally, lightweight and portable. It dynamically downloads llama runtime builds and model files, and launches models with one click (OpenAI-compatible API).

Detects multiple llama.cpp distributions, launches them with one click, and shows logs in real time; supports model management (notes, soft deletion, referenced directories) and parameter profiles.

The service process is independent of the window: closing the window does not stop the service, and reopening it automatically restores the running state.
